decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is distant from the firm's established lighting solutions and only mentioned on the website, so the firm lacks the related knowledge to interpret early results and improve it.
Medical examination light builds on the firm's established lighting offer and has its own website page, allowing the firm to assimilate and learn from early results with in-house R&D.
Industrial explosion-proof luminaires build on the firm's existing industrial lighting knowledge and show a dedicated page, so the firm can apply its related capabilities to improve the product.
Designer task light is close to the established offer as a relaunched popular product with a dedicated page, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to keep and refine it.
